title: Hello, World
intro: Your robot knows exactly one trick. Drag [b]move[/b] into the program (or just click it) once for every step, then press [b]Run[/b].
cs_note: A program is a [b]sequence[/b]: instructions run top to bottom, exactly once each. The computer does what you wrote, not what you meant.
hints: Count the floor tiles between the robot and the exit.
The exit is four steps away: four move blocks.

Each move() steps one tile in the direction the robot faces, and the robot already faces the exit. Click [b]move()[/b] four times (a click adds the block at the end of the program), then press [b]Run[/b].
